title: Replace a traffic control work training card
summary: You can order and pay for a replacement SafeWork NSW traffic control work training (TCWT) card online if it has been lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed, or if you need to convert an RMS card.
intro:
If you do traffic control work on or next to a public road, you need to have a SafeWork NSW traffic control work training (TCWT) card.

If your TCWT card has been lost, stolen, damaged or destroyed, or you need to convert your RMS card, you can order and pay for a replacement online. Your contact details must match those on your card.

If your contact details have changed, you’ll need to complete the Update contact details form before you replace your card online.

The replacement card will be sent to your postal address.
who_can_apply: You must have already been issued a traffic control work card.
what_you_need: A credit or debit card to pay the replacement fee.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a replacement card.

more_info.text: Visit Verify NSW to look up and verify a NSW licence or registration.
